page.layout: One printed page (right), one block of running text in a single column, with no marginal notes. Below the text, centred: gathering signature "T. y.". The left strip is the edge of the neighbouring page and is left out.

main_text.p: studium proficiendi in cognitione Evangelii, & fa-cultate illius prædicandi, item ad fortitudinem & prudentiam in illo prædicando, nec non ad constan-tem Evangelii confessionem; & ad tolerantiam afflictionum illius causa: vbi exponit per occasionem beneficium Dei erga electos in conferenda ipsis sa-lute seu vita æterna: item annectit consolationem qua & seipsum & Timotheum contra sua vincula consolatur: (vsque ad v. 13. Tum ad exhortationes redit, & Timotheum ad sinceritatem hortatur ac prudentiam in doctrina Evangelii proponenda: (v. 13. & 14.) Postremò occurrit offendiculo quod ex sui a quibusdam defectione poterat exoriri: cui defectioni constantiam cuiusdam Onesiphori opponit.

Cap. II. Ad exhortationes redit, ac Timotheum hortatur primùm ad alacritatem & tolerantiam in Evangelio docendo: (vsque ad v. 8.) deinde eum consolatur contra sua vincula & imminens supplicium: (vsque ad v. 14.) tertiò per digressionem quandam monet vt cohibeat contentiosos & vanos doctores: (vsque ad v. 22.) postremò ab aliis vitiis doctrinâ Evangelii deformantibus dehortatur, & commendat ei studium pacis & lenitatis in ignaris erudiendis.

Cap. III. Monet primò de hypocritis iam tum exorientibus in Ecclesiæ sinu, & postea amplius exorituris: (vsque ad v. 8.) quos vult vt Timotheus auersetur: & contra eosdem illum consolatur à turpi illorum exitu: (v. 8. 9.) Deinde ad cœptam exhortationem rediens suum ipsius exemplum Timotheo ad imitandum proponit tanquam fidelis doctoris: ac proinde Timotheum hortatur ad doctrinam

page.notes: The printed text is set in roman type with italic passages in the reference brackets. The page's left-hand running title and number are clear. The signature "T. y." is faint and may be "T. ij." [?]. The Roman numerals in the paragraph openings are set in small capitals and are transcribed as ordinary numerals. Some word endings in the first paragraph (e.g. "sui", "a") are slightly doubtful, given the old type. No marginal notes are printed on this page.
